name: Spintax cold-email bridge — unique copy per lead (and per product)

parameters.template:
{Hi|Hello|Hey} %first_name%,

{We noticed|Saw that|Noticed} %company% {carries|sells|stocks} %category% — {nice|solid|great} {lineup|selection}.

{Quick|One} {idea|thought} about your %product% {listing|page}: {?has_discount?with the {current|running} {promo|discount} at %price% it {deserves|warrants}|at %price% it {deserves|warrants}} {fresh|distinct} copy per {storefront|channel} — and with %in_stock% {plural %in_stock%: unit|units} in stock, {now|this week} is the {right|perfect} time.

{Worth|Open to} a {quick|15-minute} {look|chat} {this|next} week?

{Best|Cheers|Regards},
{Alex|Sam} from Spintax

parameters.content:
## Cold-email bridge

Sending platforms parse flat `{a|b|c}` at best — so **render here, send there**. Replace the Code node with your lead source (Google Sheets, CRM export); every row field is a `%variable%` automatically. Replace the last node with your ESP / Gmail / SMTP node and map `subject` + `body`.

Incoming values are **neutralized by default**: a scraped company name containing `{` stays text, never markup.

## Same pattern = product catalogs

Feed a **product list** instead of leads and this exact Render-per-row flow writes a **unique description per product per storefront** — no duplicate content across your sites. Conditionals (`{?has_discount?…|…}`) switch copy on data fields; `{plural %in_stock%: unit|units}` keeps counts grammatical.

## Seeds

The seed is an expression per lead (`company + ':subject'`), so every lead gets a **stable, reproducible** variant — re-running the workflow does not reshuffle sent copy. Change the suffix to re-roll everyone.
